name: @phlix/syncplay
description: Framework-agnostic SyncPlay wire protocol + NTP time-sync for Phlix JS clients (mobile, windows, tizen). The single shared, canonical implementation of the SyncPlay protocol — the server is the source of truth. No framework deps; WebSocket and clock are injected.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json

//engines: No 'engines' declared, deliberately (SPY-S9; test/packageManifest.test.ts pins the absence and carries the full posture note, phlix-syncplay-038). The package ships a committed ES2017 dist bundle for browser/RN Hermes/legacy-WebKit runtimes, so a Node floor would misstate the constraint; the real floor is dev-only (vite engines ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0, vitest engines ^22.12.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0; CI builds on Node 22/24). Sibling @phlix/ui declares engines >=18.0.0; the asymmetry is intentional. Do not add engines without rotating the manifest-test absence pin in the same commit.
//peerDependencies: @phlix/contracts is a REQUIRED (non-optional) peer: dist/messages.d.ts re-exports the SyncPlayErrorCode type from it, so type-checking consumers must install it — without it the shipped d.ts graph fails to resolve (TS2307) for any consumer that does not set skipLibCheck (phlix-syncplay-035, branch-(a) ruling: keep the re-export rooted at the package and make the peer honest, rather than gating it behind a ./types subpath that would sever the '@phlix/syncplay'-rooted seam and trim a published type surface with no observed takers — phlix-syncplay-060: estate consumers import the union from contracts directly and pin contracts themselves). The runtime bundle never imports contracts: the re-export is a pure 'export type' line, erased at build (test/errorCodeUnion.test.ts L1/L2/L3 pin that). peerDependenciesMeta is deliberately absent — declaring the peer optional would misstate the requirement; test/packageManifest.test.ts pins its absence. The range is "*" because contracts is distributed via the github: protocol (github:detain/phlix-contracts#vX.Y.Z), which semver ranges cannot match; each consumer pins the exact contracts tag directly.
author: detain
